<h2>What was built</h2>

<p><strong><code node="\[object Object]">lang/pli/atomspace.pli</code></strong> (new, \~330 lines) — an OpenCog-style hypergraph AtomSpace ported from <code node="\[object Object]">a9nn/AtomSpace.lua</code> into native membrane computing:</p>

<ul>

<li node="\[object Object]"><strong>Atoms as membranes</strong> — <code node="\[object Object]">atom\_node</code> (typed/named leaf) and <code node="\[object Object]">atom\_link</code> (a membrane that physically <em>contains</em> its endpoint atoms, so hypergraph nesting is structural, not a data structure)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><strong>Truth values</strong> — <code node="\[object Object]">tv{s,c}</code> with count-based revision (<code node="\[object Object]">s'=(s₁c₁+s₂c₂)/(c₁+c₂)</code>), matching <code node="\[object Object]">TruthValue:confidence()</code> semantics</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><strong>ECAN attention spreading</strong> — STI as a <em>conserved currency</em>: focused atoms pay a wage that flows as income to link-neighbours via antiport exchange. One maximally-parallel step diffuses STI across the whole focus — the O(1)-transition capability imperative ports can't reproduce</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><strong>Hebbian learning</strong> — co-focused atoms emit simultaneous pulses; a pulse pair wires a symmetric <code node="\[object Object]">HebbianLink</code> ("fire together, wire together")</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><strong>Pattern matcher</strong> (<code node="\[object Object]">query\_type</code> / <code node="\[object Object]">query\_link</code>) and a <strong>derived attentional focus</strong> (<code node="\[object Object]">in\_focus{}</code> flagged by threshold, not stored)</li>

</ul>

<p><strong>Supporting changes:</strong></p>

<ul>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">test\_extensions.pli</code>: +8 tests → <strong>38 total</strong> (creation, nesting, TV revision, STI conservation, Hebbian wiring, type-match, focus mark/departure)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">demo.pli</code>: +2 demos → <strong>18 total</strong> (ECAN spreading, Hebbian learning)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">integration.pli</code>: registry entry <code node="\[object Object]">module{atomspace, "1.0.0", \[nn, integration]}</code> (v2.3)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">README.md</code>: feature bullet, full AtomSpace API section, roadmap checkbox, v2.3 table, updated counts/coverage</li>

</ul>

<p><strong>Validation:</strong> all 24 <code node="\[object Object]">.pli</code> files pass <code node="\[object Object]">validate.sh</code>; secret scan clean; CodeQL N/A (no analyzable languages). No change to the shared XOR fixture, so cross-port consistency holds.</p>

<hr>

<h3>Next up — your call 🙂</h3>

<ol>

<li node="\[object Object]"><strong><code node="\[object Object]">a9nn.pli</code></strong> — NNECCO cognitive agent on top of atomspace.pli (EchoReservoir membrane, Personality, EpisodicMemory, 12-step EchoBeats as rule phases, LLaMA pool as load-balanced membranes)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><strong>P-Limbo design doc</strong> — scope the Inferno/Dis distributed-grid variant as an exploratory document (it'd be a separate <code node="\[object Object]">lang/limbo</code> port, not PLingua)</li>

</ol>

<p>My recommendation is <strong>a9nn.pli</strong> next, since it directly reuses the AtomSpace foundation we just laid. Want me to proceed?</p></div></div><div class="SessionFooter-module\_\_footer\_\_uEbNi SessionFooter-module\_\_metadataBar\_\_VBpWD"><div class="SessionFooter-module\_\_actions\_\_unnyo"><div \-- a9nn/NNECCOAgent.lua

\-- Neural Network Embodied Cognitive Coprocessor Orchestrator agent.

\--

\-- Integrates:

\--   • Echo State Reservoir Network <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> temporal processing

\--   • Multi-layer consciousness pipeline (L0-L3)

\--   • Emotion Processing Unit

\--   • OpenCog AtomSpace knowledge graph

\--   • Personality system

\--   • Parallel LLaMA.cpp orchestration (1-9 instances)

\--   • EchoBeats 12-step cognitive loop

\--   • Hardware-style register interface



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> ns     = require(<span class="hljs-string">'a9nn.nn\_ns'</span>)

<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> Tensor = ns.Tensor

<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> Class  = ns.Class

<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> nn     = ns   -- <span class="hljs-built\_in">alias</span>; TruthValue resolved lazily below



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> NNECCOAgent, parent = Class.class(<span class="hljs-string">'nn.NNECCOAgent'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'nn.CognitiveAgent'</span>)



\-- ─── EchoBeats step names ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> ECHO\_BEATS = {

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"PERCEIVE"</span>,    -- 1  raw sensory input

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"FILTER"</span>,      -- 2  attentional filtering

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"RESONATE"</span>,    -- 3  reservoir <span class="hljs-built\_in">echo</span>

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"ENCODE"</span>,      -- 4  semantic encoding

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"RECALL"</span>,      -- 5  episodic memory lookup

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"REASON"</span>,      -- 6  LLaMA inference

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"EMOTE"</span>,       -- 7  emotion update

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"PLAN"</span>,        -- 8  action selection

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"LEARN"</span>,       -- 9  RL update

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"REFLECT"</span>,     -- 10 meta-cognition

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"EXPRESS"</span>,     -- 11 output generation

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"INTEGRATE"</span>,   -- 12 state integration

}



\-- ─── Consciousness layers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> CONSCIOUSNESS\_LAYERS = {

&#x20;  \[0] = <span class="hljs-string">"DORMANT"</span>,

&#x20;  \[1] = <span class="hljs-string">"REACTIVE"</span>,

&#x20;  \[2] = <span class="hljs-string">"DELIBERATE"</span>,

&#x20;  \[3] = <span class="hljs-string">"META"</span>,

}



\-- ─── Emotion channels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> EMOTIONS = {

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"curiosity"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"joy"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"surprise"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"fear"</span>,

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"disgust"</span>,   <span class="hljs-string">"anger"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"sadness"</span>, <span class="hljs-string">"anticipation"</span>,

}



\-- ─── Constructor ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────



\--- @param opts  table:

\--   stateSize          input state dimensionality (default 64)

\--   actionSize         number of actions (default 8)

\--   reservoirSize      ESN neuron count (default 847)

\--   llamaInstances     number of LLaMA.cpp instances (default 1)

\--   basePort           first LLaMA server port (default 8080)

\--   personalityArchetype  <span class="hljs-string">"NeuroSama"</span> | <span class="hljs-string">"Analytical"</span> | nil (default <span class="hljs-string">"NeuroSama"</span>)

\--   consciousnessLayer    initial layer 0-3 (default 1)

\--   verbose            <span class="hljs-built\_in">enable</span> diagnostic output (default <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> NNECCOAgent:\_\_init(opts)

&#x20;  opts = opts or {}

&#x20;  -- Set defaults before calling parent

&#x20;  opts.stateSize  = opts.stateSize  or 64

&#x20;  opts.actionSize = opts.actionSize or 8



&#x20;  parent.\_\_init(self, opts)



&#x20;  -- ── Reservoir ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> EchoReservoir = Class.get(<span class="hljs-string">'nn.EchoReservoir'</span>)

&#x20;  self.reservoir = EchoReservoir(

&#x20;     opts.stateSize,

&#x20;     opts.reservoirSize or 847,

&#x20;     {

&#x20;        spectralRadius = opts.spectralRadius or 0.9,

&#x20;        leakRate       = opts.leakRate       or 0.7,

&#x20;        sparsity       = opts.sparsity       or 0.85,

&#x20;     }

&#x20;  )



&#x20;  -- ── Consciousness layer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

&#x20;  self.consciousnessLayer = opts.consciousnessLayer or 1

&#x20;  self.consciousnessHistory = {}



&#x20;  -- ── Emotion processing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

&#x20;  self.emotions = Tensor.zeros(#EMOTIONS)

&#x20;  self.emotionNames = EMOTIONS

&#x20;  -- Start with mild curiosity

&#x20;  self.emotions.data\[1] = 0.6



&#x20;  -- ── Personality (override archetype) ──────────────────────────────────────

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> Personality = Class.get(<span class="hljs-string">'nn.Personality'</span>)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> Personality <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> <span class="hljs-built\_in">arch</span> = opts.personalityArchetype or <span class="hljs-string">"NeuroSama"</span>

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> <span class="hljs-built\_in">arch</span> == <span class="hljs-string">"NeuroSama"</span> and Personality.NeuroSama <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;        self.personality = Personality.NeuroSama()

&#x20;     elseif <span class="hljs-built\_in">arch</span> == <span class="hljs-string">"Analytical"</span> and Personality.Analytical <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;        self.personality = Personality.Analytical()

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span>

&#x20;        self.personality = Personality(nil, opts.personalityOpts)

&#x20;     end

&#x20;  end



&#x20;  -- ── LLaMA orchestrator ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> LLaMAOrchestrator = Class.get(<span class="hljs-string">'nn.LLaMAOrchestrator'</span>)

&#x20;  self.llama = LLaMAOrchestrator({

&#x20;     numInstances = opts.llamaInstances or 1,

&#x20;     basePort     = opts.basePort       or 8080,

&#x20;     modelPath    = opts.modelPath      or <span class="hljs-string">""</span>,

&#x20;     stubMode     = opts.stubMode,      -- nil = auto-detect

&#x20;     verbose      = opts.verbose or <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,

&#x20;  })

&#x20;  self.llama:initialize()



&#x20;  -- ── Cognitive pipeline (post-reservoir encoder) ───────────────────────────

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> reservoirN = self.reservoir.reservoirN

\-- Surprise from large input change

&#x20;  self.emotions.data\[3] = math.min(1, math.max(0,

&#x20;     math.abs(novelty) \* 0.5))



&#x20;  self.registers.R3 = self.emotions:<span class="hljs-built\_in">clone</span>()

&#x20;  ctx.log\[#ctx.log+1] = string.format(<span class="hljs-string">"EMOTE: curiosity=%.2f joy=%.2f"</span>,

&#x20;     self.emotions.data\[1], self.emotions.data\[2])

end



<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> NNECCOAgent:\_beat\_PLAN(ctx)

&#x20;  self.beatMetrics\[<span class="hljs-string">"PLAN"</span>] = self.beatMetrics\[<span class="hljs-string">"PLAN"</span>] + 1

&#x20;  -- Emotion-modulated action selection

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> emotCtx = Tensor.<span class="hljs-built\_in">cat</span>(ctx.encoded, self.emotions)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> modulated = self.emotionModulator:forward(emotCtx)



&#x20;  -- Use the modulated context to produce Q-values via policy

&#x20;  -- (policy takes stateSize input; we use original filtered input)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> qvals = self.policy:forward(ctx.filteredInput)

&#x20;  self.registers.R4 = qvals

&#x20;  ctx.qvals = qvals



&#x20;  -- Select action (with ε-greedy <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> training mode)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> self.train <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     ctx.action = self:act(ctx.filteredInput)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span>

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> bestA, bestQ = 1, -math.huge

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> a = 1, self.actionSize <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> qvals.data\[a] \&gt; bestQ <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span> bestQ = qvals.data\[a]; bestA = a end

&#x20;     end

&#x20;     ctx.action = bestA

&#x20;  end



&#x20;  ctx.log\[#ctx.log+1] = string.format(<span class="hljs-string">"PLAN: action=%d qmax=%.4f"</span>,

&#x20;     ctx.action, qvals:max())

end



<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> NNECCOAgent:\_beat\_LEARN(ctx)

&#x20;  self.beatMetrics\[<span class="hljs-string">"LEARN"</span>] = self.beatMetrics\[<span class="hljs-string">"LEARN"</span>] + 1

&#x20;  -- Store experience <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> we have a complete transition

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> ctx.prevState and ctx.action and ctx.reward \~= nil <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     self:remember(ctx.prevState, ctx.action, ctx.reward,

&#x20;                   ctx.filteredInput, ctx.done or <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)

&#x20;  end

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> loss = self:learn()

&#x20;  ctx.loss   = loss

&#x20;  ctx.log\[#ctx.log+1] = loss

&#x20;     and string.format(<span class="hljs-string">"LEARN: loss=%.6f eps=%.4f"</span>, loss, self.epsilon)

&#x20;     or  <span class="hljs-string">"LEARN: memory too small, skipped"</span>

end



<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> NNECCOAgent:\_beat\_REFLECT(ctx)

&#x20;  self.beatMetrics\[<span class="hljs-string">"REFLECT"</span>] = self.beatMetrics\[<span class="hljs-string">"REFLECT"</span>] + 1

&#x20;  -- Meta-cognition: adjust consciousness layer

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> loss = ctx.loss or 0

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> loss \&gt; 0.5 <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     -- High error → increase deliberation

&#x20;     self.consciousnessLayer = math.min(3, self.consciousnessLayer + 1)

&#x20;  elseif loss \&lt; 0.01 and loss \&gt; 0 <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     -- Low error → can reduce to reactive

&#x20;     self.consciousnessLayer = math.max(1, self.consciousnessLayer - 1)

&#x20;  end

&#x20;  self.consciousnessHistory\[#self.consciousnessHistory+1] = self.consciousnessLayer

&#x20;  ctx.log\[#ctx.log+1] = string.format(<span class="hljs-string">"REFLECT: layer=%d"</span>,

&#x20;     self.consciousnessLayer)

end



<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> NNECCOAgent:\_beat\_EXPRESS(ctx)

&#x20;  self.beatMetrics\[<span class="hljs-string">"EXPRESS"</span>] = self.beatMetrics\[<span class="hljs-string">"EXPRESS"</span>] + 1

&#x20;  -- Primary output: use LLaMA response <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> available, <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> describe action

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> ctx.llamaResponse and ctx.llamaResponse.text and ctx.llamaResponse.text \~= <span class="hljs-string">""</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     ctx.output = {

&#x20;        text         = ctx.llamaResponse.text,

&#x20;        action       = ctx.action,

&#x20;        consciousness = CONSCIOUSNESS\_LAYERS\[self.consciousnessLayer],

&#x20;     }

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span>

&#x20;     ctx.output = {

&#x20;        text   = string.format(<span class="hljs-string">"Action %d selected (Q=%.3f)"</span>,

&#x20;           ctx.action, ctx.qvals and ctx.qvals.data\[ctx.action] or 0),

&#x20;        action = ctx.action,

&#x20;        consciousness = CONSCIOUSNESS\_LAYERS\[self.consciousnessLayer],

&#x20;     }

&#x20;  end

&#x20;  ctx.log\[#ctx.log+1] = <span class="hljs-string">"EXPRESS: "</span> .. ctx.output.text:sub(1, 60)

end



<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> NNECCOAgent:\_beat\_INTEGRATE(ctx)

&#x20;  self.beatMetrics\[<span class="hljs-string">"INTEGRATE"</span>] = self.beatMetrics\[<span class="hljs-string">"INTEGRATE"</span>] + 1

&#x20;  -- Store current state <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> next cycle<span class="hljs-string">'s recall

&#x20;  ctx.prevState = ctx.filteredInput



&#x20;  -- Update knowledge base with current experience

&#x20;  if self.knowledge then

&#x20;     -- Resolve TruthValue from the AtomSpace module (already loaded)

&#x20;     local atomMod = require('</span>a9nn.AtomSpace<span class="hljs-string">')

&#x20;     local tv = atomMod.TruthValue.new(math.max(0, 1 - (ctx.loss or 0)), 1)

&#x20;     -- Add an episode node for this cycle with a proper TruthValue object

&#x20;     self.knowledge:addNode("EpisodeNode", "cycle\_" .. self.cycleCount, tv)

&#x20;  end



&#x20;  -- Advance registers

&#x20;  self.registers.PC = (self.registers.PC % 12) + 1

&#x20;  ctx.log\[#ctx.log+1] = string.format("INTEGRATE: cycle=%d complete", self.cycleCount)

end



\-- ─── Utility ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────



\--- Encode a text string as a fixed-size feature vector.

\-- Uses character n-gram frequencies mapped to (stateSize,) Tensor.

function NNECCOAgent:\_encodeText(text)

&#x20;  local n   = self.stateSize

&#x20;  local out = Tensor.zeros(n)

&#x20;  -- Simple char-level hashing into bins

&#x20;  for i = 1, #text do

&#x20;     local c   = string.byte(text, i)

&#x20;     local bin = ((c \* 31 + i \* 7) % n) + 1

&#x20;     out.data\[bin] = out.data\[bin] + 1

&#x20;  end

&#x20;  -- L2-normalise

&#x20;  local norm = out:norm()

&#x20;  if norm \&gt; 1e-6 then

&#x20;     for i = 1, n do out.data\[i] = out.data\[i] / norm end

&#x20;  end

&#x20;  return out

end



\--- Return a hardware-style status dump.

function NNECCOAgent:getHardwareStatus()

&#x20;  local llamaStatus = self.llama:getStatus()

&#x20;  return {

&#x20;     agentID     = self.id,

&#x20;     cycle       = self.cycleCount,

&#x20;     reservoir   = {

&#x20;        size          = self.reservoir.reservoirN,

&#x20;        spectralRadius = self.reservoir.spectralRadius,

&#x20;        leakRate      = self.reservoir.leakRate,

&#x20;        stateNorm     = self.registers.R1:norm(),

&#x20;     },

&#x20;     consciousness = {

&#x20;        layer    = self.consciousnessLayer,

&#x20;        name     = CONSCIOUSNESS\_LAYERS\[self.consciousnessLayer],

&#x20;        history  = self.consciousnessHistory,

&#x20;     },

&#x20;     emotions = (function()

&#x20;        local t = {}

&#x20;        for i, name in ipairs(self.emotionNames) do

&#x20;           t\[name] = self.emotions.data\[i]

&#x20;        end

&#x20;        return t

&#x20;     end)(),

&#x20;     llama       = llamaStatus,

&#x20;     registers   = {

&#x20;        PC  = self.registers.PC,

&#x20;        STA = self.registers.STA,

&#x20;     },

&#x20;     beatMetrics = self.beatMetrics,

&#x20;     memory      = {

&#x20;        size     = self.memory:size(),

&#x20;        capacity = self.memory.capacity,

&#x20;     },

&#x20;     policy = {

&#x20;        epsilon = self.epsilon,

&#x20;        steps   = self.stepCount,

&#x20;     },

&#x20;  }

end



function NNECCOAgent:\_\_tostring\_\_()

&#x20;  return string.format(

&#x20;     "nn.NNECCOAgent(id=%d, reservoir=%d, llama=%d, layer=%s)",

&#x20;     self.id,

&#x20;     self.reservoir.reservoirN,

&#x20;     self.llama.numInstances,

&#x20;     CONSCIOUSNESS\_LAYERS\[self.consciousnessLayer])

end



return NNECCOAgent

class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_codeContainer\_\_YJrZ9"><pre class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_code\_\_X8Whj"><code class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_codeWrap\_\_HyFh6">$ sed -n <span \-- a9nn/EchoReservoir.lua

\-- Echo State Network (ESN / Liquid State Machine) reservoir layer.

\--

\-- An ESN consists of:

\--   • A fixed (untrained) recurrent reservoir of N neurons

\--   • An input weight matrix W\_in  (N × inSize)

\--   • A reservoir weight matrix W\_res (N × N)  with spectral radius \&lt; 1

\--   • An optional output layer (trained separately or via nn.Linear)

\--

\-- The reservoir maps a sequence of inputs to a high-dimensional state

\-- trajectory, enabling rich temporal feature extraction.

\--

\-- Reference: Jaeger (2001) <span class="hljs-string">"The echo state approach to analysing and training

\-- recurrent neural networks"</span>



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> nn     = require(<span class="hljs-string">'a9nn.nn\_ns'</span>)

<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> Tensor = nn.Tensor

<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> Class  = nn.Class



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> EchoReservoir, parent = Class.class(<span class="hljs-string">'nn.EchoReservoir'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'nn.Module'</span>)



\--- Constructor.

\-- @param inSize      dimensionality of each input step

\-- @param reservoirN  number of reservoir neurons (default 100)

\-- @param opts        table of optional parameters:

\--   spectralRadius   target spectral radius  (default 0.9)

\--   sparsity         fraction of zero weights (default 0.8)

\--   leakRate         leaking rate α ∈ (0,1]  (default 1.0)

\--   inputScaling     scaling <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> W\_in         (default 1.0)

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> EchoReservoir:\_\_init(inSize, reservoirN, opts)

&#x20;  parent.\_\_init(self)

&#x20;  opts = opts or {}



&#x20;  self.inSize        = inSize

&#x20;  self.reservoirN    = reservoirN or 100

&#x20;  self.spectralRadius = opts.spectralRadius or 0.9

&#x20;  self.sparsity       = opts.sparsity       or 0.8

&#x20;  self.leakRate       = opts.leakRate       or 1.0

&#x20;  self.inputScaling   = opts.inputScaling   or 1.0



&#x20;  -- Initialise fixed weight matrices

&#x20;  self:\_initWeights()



&#x20;  -- Current hidden state

&#x20;  self.state = Tensor.zeros(self.reservoirN)



&#x20;  -- Output = concatenation of state (and optionally input)

&#x20;  self.output = Tensor.zeros(self.reservoirN)

end



<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> EchoReservoir:\_initWeights()

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> N   = self.reservoirN

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> M   = self.inSize



&#x20;  -- W\_in: (N × M) scaled uniform

&#x20;  self.W\_in = Tensor.zeros(N, M)

&#x20;  self.W\_in:uniform(self.inputScaling)



&#x20;  -- W\_res: (N × N) sparse, rescaled to desired spectral radius

&#x20;  self.W\_res = Tensor.zeros(N, N)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i = 1, N <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> j = 1, N <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> math.random() \&gt; self.sparsity <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;           self.W\_res.data\[(i-1)\*N+j] = (math.random() \* 2 - 1)

&#x20;        end

&#x20;     end

&#x20;  end



&#x20;  -- Approximate spectral radius by power iteration

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> rho = self:\_powerIteration(self.W\_res, 20)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> rho \&gt; 1e-6 <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> scale = self.spectralRadius / rho

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i = 1, N\*N <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;        self.W\_res.data\[i] = self.W\_res.data\[i] \* scale

&#x20;     end

&#x20;  end

end



\--- Approximate largest eigenvalue magnitude via power iteration.

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> EchoReservoir:\_powerIteration(W, iters)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> N = W.size\_\[1]

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> v = Tensor.zeros(N)

&#x20;  -- Random start

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i = 1, N <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span> v.data\[i] = math.random() \* 2 - 1 end



&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> norm = v:norm()

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> norm \&lt; 1e-10 <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span> <span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span> 0 end

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i = 1, N <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span> v.data\[i] = v.data\[i] / norm end



&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> rho = 0

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> \_ = 1, iters <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> Wv = W:<span class="hljs-built\_in">mv</span>(v)

&#x20;     rho = Wv:norm()

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> rho \&lt; 1e-10 <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span> <span class="hljs-built\_in">break</span> end

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i = 1, N <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span> v.data\[i] = Wv.data\[i] / rho end

&#x20;  end

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span> rho

end



\--- Reset the reservoir state to zeros.

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> EchoReservoir:resetState()

&#x20;  self.state:zero()

end



\--- Forward pass <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> a SINGLE <span class="hljs-keyword">time</span> step.

\-- @param input  Tensor of shape (inSize,)

\-- @<span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span>       Tensor of shape (reservoirN,) — reservoir state

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> EchoReservoir:updateOutput(input)

&#x20;  assert(input.size\_\[1] == self.inSize,

&#x20;     string.format(<span class="hljs-string">"EchoReservoir: expected input size %d, got %d"</span>,

&#x20;        self.inSize, input.size\_\[1]))



&#x20;  -- pre-activation = W\_in · u + W\_res · x(t-1)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> u  = self.W\_in:<span class="hljs-built\_in">mv</span>(input)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> Wx = self.W\_res:<span class="hljs-built\_in">mv</span>(self.state)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> pre = u:add(Wx)



&#x20;  -- activation with tanh

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> newState = pre:apply(math.tanh)

class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_codeContainer\_\_YJrZ9"><pre class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_code\_\_X8Whj"><code class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_codeWrap\_\_HyFh6">$ sed -n <span class="hljs-string">'1,110p'</span> /home/runner/work/nn.nn/nn.nn/lang/a9nn/Personality.lua

\-- a9nn/Personality.lua

\-- Personality tensor system <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> cognitive agents.

\--

\-- A Personality is a fixed-size vector of trait dimensions, each <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> \[0,1].

\-- Traits can be <span class="hljs-built\_in">read</span>/written individually and drift over <span class="hljs-keyword">time</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> response to

\-- experiences.  The system mirrors the <span class="hljs-string">"personality tensor"</span> concept described

\-- <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> the NNECCO / Neuro-Sama architecture.



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> nn     = require(<span class="hljs-string">'a9nn.nn\_ns'</span>)

<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> Tensor = nn.Tensor

<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> Class  = nn.Class



\-- ─── Default trait <span class="hljs-built\_in">set</span> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> DEFAULT\_TRAITS = {

&#x20;  -- Cognitive

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"intelligence"</span>,   -- general reasoning ability

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"creativity"</span>,     -- divergent thinking

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"curiosity"</span>,      -- drive to explore

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"focus"</span>,          -- sustained attention



&#x20;  -- Social / affective

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"empathy"</span>,        -- sensitivity to others

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"warmth"</span>,         -- friendliness

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"playfulness"</span>,    -- humour / levity

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"assertiveness"</span>,  -- confidence <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> expression



&#x20;  -- Stability

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"stability"</span>,      -- emotional regulation

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"openness"</span>,       -- receptivity to new ideas

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"conscientiousness"</span>, -- reliability / thoroughness

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-string">"resilience"</span>,     -- recovery from setbacks

}



\-- ─── Personality ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> Personality, \_ = Class.class(<span class="hljs-string">'nn.Personality'</span>)



\--- @param traits  table of trait names (optional, uses DEFAULT\_TRAITS)

\--- @param values  table of initial values indexed by name or position (optional)

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> Personality:\_\_init(traits, values)

&#x20;  self.traits     = traits or DEFAULT\_TRAITS

&#x20;  self.n          = <span class="hljs-comment">#self.traits</span>

&#x20;  self.traitIndex = {}

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i, name <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> ipairs(self.traits) <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;     self.traitIndex\[name] = i

&#x20;  end



&#x20;  -- Underlying tensor (all 0.5 by default = neutral)

&#x20;  self.tensor = Tensor.zeros(self.n)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i = 1, self.n <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span> self.tensor.data\[i] = 0.5 end



&#x20;  -- Apply supplied initial values

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> values <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> <span class="hljs-built\_in">type</span>(values) == <span class="hljs-string">"table"</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> k, v <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> pairs(values) <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;           <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> <span class="hljs-built\_in">type</span>(k) == <span class="hljs-string">"string"</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;              self:<span class="hljs-built\_in">set</span>(k, v)

&#x20;           elseif <span class="hljs-built\_in">type</span>(k) == <span class="hljs-string">"number"</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;              self.tensor.data\[k] = math.min(1, math.max(0, v))

&#x20;           end

&#x20;        end

&#x20;     end

&#x20;  end



&#x20;  -- Momentum buffer <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> drift updates

&#x20;  self.\_momentum = Tensor.zeros(self.n)

&#x20;  self.driftRate = 0.01

&#x20;  self.momentumDecay = 0.9

end



\--- Get the value of a single trait by name or index.

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> Personality:get(nameOrIdx)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> idx = <span class="hljs-built\_in">type</span>(nameOrIdx) == <span class="hljs-string">"string"</span>

&#x20;     and self.traitIndex\[nameOrIdx] or nameOrIdx

&#x20;  assert(idx, <span class="hljs-string">"Personality: unknown trait: "</span> .. tostring(nameOrIdx))

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span> self.tensor.data\[idx]

end

class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_codeContainer\_\_YJrZ9"><pre class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_code\_\_X8Whj"><code class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_codeWrap\_\_HyFh6">$ sed -n <span \-- @param experience  table with fields: state, action, reward, next\_state, <span class="hljs-keyword">done</span>

\-- @param priority    optional initial priority (defaults to max seen so far)

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> EpisodicMemory:push(experience, priority)

&#x20;  priority = priority or self.maxPriority

&#x20;  self.buffer\[self.head]     = experience

&#x20;  self.priorities\[self.head] = priority

&#x20;  self.maxPriority = math.max(self.maxPriority, priority)

&#x20;  self.head  = (self.head % self.capacity) + 1

&#x20;  self.count = math.min(self.count + 1, self.capacity)

end



\--- Sample a batch of `n` experiences.

\-- @param n    batch size

\-- @<span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span>     table of experience tables, table of indices, table of IS-weights

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> EpisodicMemory:sample(n)

&#x20;  n = math.min(n, self.count)

&#x20;  assert(n \&gt; 0, <span class="hljs-string">"EpisodicMemory: empty buffer"</span>)



&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> experiences = {}

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> indices     = {}

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> weights     = {}



&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> self.prioritised <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     -- Compute probability distribution

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> prioSum = 0

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i = 1, self.count <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;        prioSum = prioSum + (self.priorities\[i]^self.alpha)

&#x20;     end



&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> minProb = (self.eps^self.alpha) / prioSum

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> maxW    = (minProb \* self.count)^(-self.beta)



&#x20;     -- Sample without replacement using a simple alias-free approach

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> chosen = {}

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> chosenSet = {}

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">while</span> <span class="hljs-comment">#chosen \&lt; n do</span>

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> r    = math.random() \* prioSum

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> cum  = 0

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> added = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i = 1, self.count <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;           cum = cum + (self.priorities\[i]^self.alpha)

&#x20;           <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> cum \&gt;= r and not chosenSet\[i] <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;              chosen\[#chosen+1] = i

&#x20;              chosenSet\[i]      = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>

&#x20;              added = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>

&#x20;              <span class="hljs-built\_in">break</span>

&#x20;           end

&#x20;        end

&#x20;        -- safety: <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> weighted-random walk found no unchosen item

&#x20;        -- (can happen when all items are already chosen), pick a random one

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> not added <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;           <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> \_ = 1, self.count <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;              <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> idx = math.random(self.count)

&#x20;              <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> not chosenSet\[idx] <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;                 chosen\[#chosen+1] = idx

&#x20;                 chosenSet\[idx]    = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>

&#x20;                 added = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>

&#x20;                 <span class="hljs-built\_in">break</span>

&#x20;              end

&#x20;           end

&#x20;           -- If still not added (all items exhausted), <span class="hljs-built\_in">break</span> to avoid infinite loop

&#x20;           <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> not added <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span> <span class="hljs-built\_in">break</span> end

&#x20;        end

&#x20;     end



&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> k, idx <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> ipairs(chosen) <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> prob = (self.priorities\[idx]^self.alpha) / prioSum

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> w    = ((prob \* self.count)^(-self.beta)) / maxW

&#x20;        experiences\[k] = self.buffer\[idx]

&#x20;        indices\[k]     = idx

&#x20;        weights\[k]     = w

&#x20;     end

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span>

&#x20;     -- Uniform random sampling

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> pool = {}

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i = 1, self.count <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span> pool\[i] = i end

&#x20;     -- Fisher-Yates shuffle first n

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i = 1, n <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> j = math.random(i, <span class="hljs-comment">#pool)</span>

&#x20;        pool\[i], pool\[j] = pool\[j], pool\[i]

&#x20;     end

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> k = 1, n <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;        experiences\[k] = self.buffer\[pool\[k]]

&#x20;        indices\[k]     = pool\[k]

&#x20;        weights\[k]     = 1.0

&#x20;     end

&#x20;  end



&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span> experiences, indices, weights

end

\-- a9nn/LLaMAOrchestrator.lua

\-- Orchestrator <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> 1-9 parallel LLaMA.cpp local-inference instances.

\--

\-- Each instance is assumed to be a running llama.cpp server (--server mode)

\-- listening on a different HTTP port.  Requests are dispatched via the

\-- `/completion` REST endpoint.

\--

\-- In environments without llama.cpp, the orchestrator falls back to a

\-- stub <span class="hljs-string">"echo"</span> backend so that the cognitive pipeline can still run.

\--

\-- Port assignment: instance k uses port (basePort + k - 1).

\-- Default base port: 8080.  Max instances: 9.



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> nn    = require(<span class="hljs-string">'a9nn.nn\_ns'</span>)

<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> Class = nn.Class



\-- Try to load a lightweight HTTP library (<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> present <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> the environment)

<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> http = nil

pcall(<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span>()

&#x20;  http = require(<span class="hljs-string">'socket.http'</span>)  -- LuaSocket

end)

<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> not http <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;  pcall(<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span>()

&#x20;     http = require(<span class="hljs-string">'http'</span>)       -- custom binding

&#x20;  end)

end



\-- ─── Instance record ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> makeInstance(<span class="hljs-built\_in">id</span>, port)

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span> {

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">id</span>           = <span class="hljs-built\_in">id</span>,

&#x20;     port         = port,

&#x20;     available    = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,

&#x20;     tokensServed = 0,

&#x20;     requests     = 0,

&#x20;     errors       = 0,

&#x20;     lastLatencyMs = 0,

&#x20;  }

end



\-- ─── LLaMAOrchestrator ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────



<span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> LLaMAOrchestrator, \_ = Class.class(<span class="hljs-string">'nn.LLaMAOrchestrator'</span>)



\--- Constructor.

\-- @param opts   table:

\--   numInstances  number of instances (1-9, default 1)

\--   basePort      port <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> first instance (default 8080)

\--   modelPath     path to .gguf model (informational)

\--   <span class="hljs-built\_in">timeout</span>       HTTP <span class="hljs-built\_in">timeout</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> seconds (default 30)

\--   stubMode      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>, use <span class="hljs-built\_in">echo</span> stub without real HTTP (default: auto)

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> LLaMAOrchestrator:\_\_init(opts)

&#x20;  opts = opts or {}

&#x20;  self.numInstances = math.min(9, math.max(1, opts.numInstances or 1))

&#x20;  self.basePort     = opts.basePort  or 8080

&#x20;  self.modelPath    = opts.modelPath or <span class="hljs-string">""</span>

&#x20;  self.timeout      = opts.timeout   or 30

&#x20;  self.stubMode     = opts.stubMode



&#x20;  -- Auto-detect stub mode <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> no HTTP library available

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> self.stubMode == nil <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     self.stubMode = (http == nil)

&#x20;  end



&#x20;  -- Build instance pool

&#x20;  self.instances = {}

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> i = 1, self.numInstances <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;     self.instances\[i] = makeInstance(i, self.basePort + i - 1)

&#x20;  end



&#x20;  -- Request queue

&#x20;  self.queue = {}



&#x20;  self.initialized = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>

&#x20;  self.verbose     = opts.verbose or <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>

end



\--- Initialize (ping each instance to verify reachability).

\-- In stub mode this always succeeds.

\-- @<span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span>  <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> at least one instance is reachable

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> LLaMAOrchestrator:initialize()

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> self.stubMode <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> self.verbose <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-built\_in">print</span>(string.format(

&#x20;           <span class="hljs-string">"\[LLaMAOrchestrator] Stub mode: %d virtual instance(s) on ports %d-%d"</span>,

&#x20;           self.numInstances, self.basePort, self.basePort + self.numInstances - 1))

&#x20;     end

&#x20;     self.initialized = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span> <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>

&#x20;  end



&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> ok = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> \_, inst <span class="hljs-keyword">in</span> ipairs(self.instances) <span class="hljs-keyword">do</span>

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> alive = self:\_ping(inst)

&#x20;     inst.available = alive

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> alive <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span> ok = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> end

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> self.verbose <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;        <span class="hljs-built\_in">print</span>(string.format(<span class="hljs-string">"\[LLaMAOrchestrator] Instance %d (port %d): %s"</span>,

&#x20;           inst.id, inst.port, alive and <span class="hljs-string">"UP"</span> or <span class="hljs-string">"DOWN"</span>))

&#x20;     end

&#x20;  end

&#x20;  self.initialized = ok

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span> ok

end



\--- Send a completion request.

\-- @param prompt   string

\-- @param params   table: temperature, max\_tokens, top\_p, stop

\-- @<span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span>         table: text, tokens, instance\_id, latency\_ms

<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> LLaMAOrchestrator:generate(prompt, params)

&#x20;  params = params or {}

&#x20;  assert(self.initialized, <span class="hljs-string">"LLaMAOrchestrator: call initialize() first"</span>)



&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> inst = self:\_selectInstance()

&#x20;  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> not inst <span class="hljs-keyword">then</span>

&#x20;     <span class="hljs-built\_in">return</span> {text = <span class="hljs-string">""</span>, error = <span class="hljs-string">"No available instances"</span>}

&#x20;  end



&#x20;  <span class="hljs-built\_in">local</span> t0 = os.clock()

<p>Port <code node="\[object Object]">a9nn/NNECCOAgent.lua</code> (+ EchoReservoir, Personality, EpisodicMemory, LLaMAOrchestrator) into native membrane computing, building on v2.3 <code node="\[object Object]">atomspace.pli</code>.</p>

<ul class="contains-task-list">

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox" checked=""> Phase 1 <code node="\[object Object]">atomspace.pli</code> merged (38 tests, 18 demos)</li>

<ul>

<li node="\[object Object]">Echo State Reservoir membrane (leaky-integrator neurons, spectral radius, tanh)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]">12-step <strong>EchoBeats</strong> loop as sequential rule phases (PERCEIVE…INTEGRATE) driven by a program-counter register</li>

<li node="\[object Object]">Emotion Processing Unit (8 channels, novelty/reward-driven update)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]">Consciousness layers L0–L3 with loss-driven meta-cognitive transitions</li>

<li node="\[object Object]">PLAN beat: emotion-modulated argmax action selection</li>

<li node="\[object Object]">Episodic memory membrane (priority-weighted experience tuples)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]">LLaMA pool: 1–9 instance membranes with least-load antiport dispatch (stub mode)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]">Hardware-style virtual registers (R0–R4, PC, STA)</li>

</ul>

</li>

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Append a9nn tests to <code node="\[object Object]">test\_extensions.pli</code></li>

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Append a9nn demo(s) to <code node="\[object Object]">demo.pli</code></li>

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> Register <code node="\[object Object]">a9nn</code> in <code node="\[object Object]">integration.pli</code> module\_registry</li>

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox"> <code node="\[object Object]">bash lang/pli/validate.sh</code> passes</li>

<p>Port <code node="\[object Object]">a9nn/NNECCOAgent.lua</code> (+ EchoReservoir, Personality, EpisodicMemory, LLaMAOrchestrator) into native membrane computing, building on v2.3 <code node="\[object Object]">atomspace.pli</code>.</p>

<ul class="contains-task-list">

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox" checked=""> Phase 1 <code node="\[object Object]">atomspace.pli</code> merged (38 tests, 18 demos)</li>

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox" checked=""> Write <code node="\[object Object]">lang/pli/a9nn.pli</code>:

<ul>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">echo\_reservoir</code> — ESN membrane of leaky-integrator neurons (spectral radius, leak rate, tanh)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">echobeats\_driver</code> — 12-step loop phase-locked by a PC register (PERCEIVE…INTEGRATE)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">emotion\_unit</code> — 8 channels with novelty/reward-driven updates</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">consciousness</code> — L0–L3 with loss-driven REFLECT transitions</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">planner</code> — emotion-modulated argmax action selection</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">episodic\_memory</code> — prioritised replay (circular buffer, priority objects)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">llama\_pool</code> — 1–9 instance membranes, least-load antiport dispatch, stub echo</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">nnecco\_agent</code> model — hardware registers R0–R4/PC/STA + AtomSpace INTEGRATE</li>

</ul>

</li>

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox" checked=""> Append 8 a9nn tests to <code node="\[object Object]">test\_extensions.pli</code> (38 → 46 total)</li>

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox" checked=""> Append a9nn NNECCO demo to <code node="\[object Object]">demo.pli</code> (18 → 19 total)</li>

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox" checked=""> Register <code node="\[object Object]">a9nn</code> in <code node="\[object Object]">integration.pli</code> module\_registry (deps: nn, atomspace, integration)</li>

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox" checked=""> Update <code node="\[object Object]">lang/pli/README.md</code> — feature bullet, a9nn API section, roadmap, v2.3 table, counts (46 tests / 19 demos), coverage list</li>

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox" checked=""> <code node="\[object Object]">bash lang/pli/validate.sh</code> passes for all 25 files</li>

<li class="task-list-item" node="\[object Object]"><input disabled="" type="checkbox" checked=""> Secret scan clean; CodeQL N/A (no analyzable languages)</li>

<h2>What was built</h2>

<p><strong><code node="\[object Object]">lang/pli/a9nn.pli</code></strong> (new, \~380 lines) — a faithful membrane-computing port of <code node="\[object Object]">a9nn/NNECCOAgent.lua</code> and its cognitive stack, layered on the v2.3 <code node="\[object Object]">atomspace.pli</code>:</p>

<table><thead><tr><th>NNECCO subsystem (Lua)</th><th>P-Systems mapping</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><strong>EchoReservoir</strong></td><td><code node="\[object Object]">echo\_reservoir</code> — membrane of leaky-integrator neurons, recurrent <code node="\[object Object]">synapse{i,j,w}</code> objects, <code node="\[object Object]">x'=(1-a)x + a·tanh(pre)</code>; one maximally-parallel step = one reservoir tick</td></tr><tr><td><strong>EchoBeats (12-step)</strong></td><td><code node="\[object Object]">echobeats\_driver</code> — a <strong>PC register (1..12)</strong> gates which rule phase fires, cycling PERCEIVE→…→INTEGRATE; the sequential method chain becomes a phase-locked parallel rule system</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Emotion Processing Unit</strong></td><td><code node="\[object Object]">emotion\_unit</code> — 8 channels (curiosity/joy/surprise/…) with the exact novelty/reward update laws from <code node="\[object Object]">\_beat\_EMOTE</code></td></tr><tr><td><strong>Consciousness L0–L3</strong></td><td><code node="\[object Object]">consciousness</code> — layer register moved by loss-driven REFLECT rules (<code node="\[object Object]">\&gt;0.5</code>→deliberate, <code node="\[object Object]">\&lt;0.01</code>→reactive)</td></tr><tr><td><strong>EpisodicMemory</strong></td><td><code node="\[object Object]">episodic\_memory</code> — circular membrane of experience tuples + priority objects, head wraps mod capacity</td></tr><tr><td><strong>LLaMAOrchestrator</strong></td><td><code node="\[object Object]">llama\_pool</code> — 1–9 instance membranes, <strong>least-load dispatch via antiport</strong>, stub-mode echo, ports <code node="\[object Object]">base+k-1</code></td></tr><tr><td><strong>PLAN / policy</strong></td><td><code node="\[object Object]">planner</code> — emotion-modulated argmax action selection</td></tr><tr><td><strong>Hardware registers</strong></td><td><code node="\[object Object]">nnecco\_agent</code> model — R0–R4, PC, STA as membrane objects; INTEGRATE writes an <code node="\[object Object]">EpisodeNode</code> into the AtomSpace each cycle</td></tr></tbody></table>

<p><strong>Supporting changes:</strong></p>

<ul>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">test\_extensions.pli</code>: +8 tests → <strong>46 total</strong> (reservoir tick, PC cycling, emotion update, REFLECT, memory wrap, LLaMA least-load, PLAN argmax, INTEGRATE episode strength)</li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">demo.pli</code>: +1 NNECCO EchoBeats demo → <strong>19 total</strong></li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">integration.pli</code>: registry <code node="\[object Object]">module{a9nn, "1.0.0", \[nn, atomspace, integration]}</code></li>

<li node="\[object Object]"><code node="\[object Object]">README.md</code>: feature bullet, full a9nn API section, roadmap checkbox, v2.3 table row, counts (46 tests / 19 demos), coverage list</li>

</ul>

<p><strong>Validation:</strong> all 25 <code node="\[object Object]">.pli</code> files pass <code node="\[object Object]">validate.sh</code>; secret scan clean; CodeQL N/A (PLingua/Markdown not analyzable). No change to the shared XOR fixture, so all 7 ports remain numerically consistent.</p>

<hr>

<h3>The full hybrid stack now exists in membrane computing 🎉</h3>

<p><code node="\[object Object]">nn.pli</code> (deep learning) → <code node="\[object Object]">gnn/attention/transformer</code> (architectures) → <code node="\[object Object]">atomspace.pli</code> (symbolic hypergraph) → <code node="\[object Object]">a9nn.pli</code> (embodied cognitive agent on top).</p>

<p><strong>Remaining frontier:</strong> the <strong>P-Limbo</strong> idea — a P-Systems variant targeting the Inferno/Dis distributed VM (membranes as Dis processes, communication rules as channel message-passing over Styx/9P, membrane tree = process tree). That's a genuinely different runtime, so I'd scope it as a <strong>design doc + minimal prototype</strong> in a new <code node="\[object Object]">lang/limbo/</code> rather than PLingua. Want me to draft that next?</p></div></div><div class="SessionFooter-module\_\_footer\_\_uEbNi SessionFooter-module\_\_metadataBar\_\_VBpWD"><div class="SessionFooter-module\_\_actions\_\_unnyo"><div Contents of https<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span><span class="hljs-comment">//raw.githubusercontent.com/cogpy/rrpling/48c5b1e42d4169271c6d3c8da7558081e06314e0/README.md:</span>

\# RR-PLingua<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Relevance Realization Enhanced Membrane Computing



\*\*RR-PLingua\*\* is an advanced membrane computing framework that integrates \*\*Relevance Realization (RR)\*\* dynamics with \*\*OpenCog AtomSpace\*\* symbolic reasoning<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> creating a unified platform for membrane computing with cognitive architectures.



\## 🧠 RR-RNN<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Relevance Realization with Recursive Neural Networks



This implementation extends the traditional P-Lingua framework with four major Next Development Directions<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> creating a sophisticated system for symbolic-subsymbolic integration in membrane computing environments.



\### ✨ Key Features



\- \*\*🔗 Advanced PLN Integration\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Probabilistic Logic Networks with RR pattern reasoning

\- \*\*💬 Enhanced Scheme Interface\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Interactive REPL for system exploration and manipulation

\- \*\*💾 Persistent AtomSpace\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> JSON serialization and incremental learning capabilities

\- \*\*🏗️ Multi-Level Integration\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Hierarchical membrane structures with cross-level emergence



\## 🎯 Implementation Summary



\### <span class="hljs-number">1.</span> Advanced PLN Integration ✅

\*\*File\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> `include/pln\_integration.hpp`



\- \*\*PLN Truth Values\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Complete implementation with strength/confidence pairs

\- \*\*Inference Rules\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> 

&#x20; - Deduction<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> A→B<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> A ⊢ B 

&#x20; - Abduction<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> A→B<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> B ⊢ A (with reduced confidence)

\- \*\*RR Pattern Implications\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Automatic generation of implications from high-coupling agent-arena relationships

\- \*\*Full Inference Cycle\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Integrated PLN reasoning over membrane structures



\### <span class="hljs-number">2.</span> Enhanced Scheme Interface ✅

\*\*File\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> `include/scheme\_interface.hpp`



\- \*\*Interactive REPL\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Full Scheme-style command evaluation

\- \*\*Command Set\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> <span class="hljs-number">8</span>+ commands for system exploration and manipulation

\- \*\*Pattern Matching\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Query and analyze both RR and AtomSpace structures

\- \*\*Real-time Updates\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Modify system state through Scheme commands



\### <span class="hljs-number">3.</span> Persistent AtomSpace ✅

\*\*File\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> `include/persistent\_atomspace.hpp`



\- \*\*JSON Serialization\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Complete save/load for AtomSpace state

\- \*\*RR Hypergraph Persistence\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Serialize all RR dynamics and structure

\- \*\*Incremental Learning\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Merge new experiences with existing knowledge

\- \*\*Memory Consolidation\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Remove low-confidence atoms to optimize storage



\### <span class="hljs-number">4.</span> Multi-Level Integration ✅

\*\*Distributed across\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> `relevance\_realization.hpp`<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> `atomspace\_integration.hpp`<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> test files



\- \*\*Hierarchical Structures\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Support for nested membrane architectures

\- \*\*Cross-Level Emergence\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Detection of patterns spanning multiple hierarchy levels

\- \*\*Temporal Reasoning\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Track relevance evolution over time

\- \*\*Multi-Scale Dynamics\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Coordinated RR updates across system levels

\## 🔄 RR Dynamics Process Flow



```mermaid

sequenceDiagram

&#x20;   participant Agent as Agent Membrane

&#x20;   participant Arena as Arena Membrane

&#x20;   participant RR as RR Engine

&#x20;   participant AtomSpace as AtomSpace

&#x20;   participant PLN as PLN Engine

&#x20;   

&#x20;   Agent-\&gt;\&gt;RR<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Update salience

&#x20;   Arena-\&gt;\&gt;RR<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Update affordances

&#x20;   RR-\&gt;\&gt;RR<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Compute trialectic dynamics

&#x20;   RR-\&gt;\&gt;AtomSpace<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Sync RR properties

&#x20;   AtomSpace-\&gt;\&gt;PLN<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Generate implications

&#x20;   PLN-\&gt;\&gt;PLN<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Perform inference cycle

&#x20;   PLN-\&gt;\&gt;AtomSpace<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Update truth values

&#x20;   AtomSpace-\&gt;\&gt;RR<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Feedback to RR dynamics

&#x20;   RR-\&gt;\&gt;Agent<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Update relevance gradient

&#x20;   RR-\&gt;\&gt;Arena<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Update coupling strength

```



\## 🚀 Quick Start



\### Dependencies



```bash

sudo apt-get install build-essential flex bison libboost-filesystem-dev libboost-program-options-dev libfl-dev

```



\### Build \&amp; Test



```bash

\# Build traditional P-Lingua

make grammar

make compiler

make simulator



\# Build RR-enhanced test programs

g++ -I./include -std=c++<span class="hljs-number">11</span> -o test\_rr\_enhanced test\_rr\_enhanced.cpp

g++ -I./include -std=c++<span class="hljs-number">11</span> -o test\_next\_directions test\_next\_directions.cpp

g++ -I./include -std=c++<span class="hljs-number">11</span> -o demo\_repl demo\_repl.cpp



\# Run comprehensive demo

./test\_next\_directions

```



\### Interactive RR/AtomSpace REPL



```bash

./demo\_repl

```



Available Scheme commands<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span>

```scheme

(list-rr-nodes)           ; List all RR nodes with properties

(list-atoms)              ; Show AtomSpace contents  

(get-system-relevance)    ; Compute overall system relevance

(run-pln-inference)       ; Execute PLN reasoning cycle

(find-patterns)           ; Detect emergent patterns

(get-salience node-ID)    ; Query node salience

(update-salience node-ID VALUE) ; Modify node properties

(find-atom <span class="hljs-string">"NAME"</span>)        ; Search atoms by name

```



\## 📊 Performance Characteristics



\### RR Dynamics Complexity

\- \*\*Trialectic Updates\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> O(n) per node per timestep

\- \*\*Coupling Computation\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> O(n²) for agent-arena pairs

\- \*\*Emergence Detection\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> O(n·m) for n agents<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> m arenas



\### AtomSpace Integration

\- \*\*RR→Atom Conversion\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> O(n) for n RR nodes

\- \*\*PLN Inference\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> O(r·a) for r rules<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> a atoms

\- \*\*Pattern Matching\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> O(p·log(a)) for p patterns



\## 🔬 Research Applications



\### Cognitive Architecture Integration

\- \*\*Symbolic-Subsymbolic Bridge\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> RR provides the dynamic foundation for symbolic reasoning

\- \*\*Emergent Pattern Recognition\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Multi-level emergence detection across membrane hierarchies

\- \*\*Adaptive Learning\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> Persistent storage enables i

Contents of https<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span><span class="hljs-comment">//raw.githubusercontent.com/ReZorg/plingua/547338824568810b1a14a950189e7a5dc799ee97/README.md:</span>

\# P-Lingua — Consolidated Membrane Computing Platform



Unified framework for \*\*P-systems\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> \*\*M-systems (Morphogenetic Systems)\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> \*\*Relevance Realization\*\*<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> and \*\*OpenCog AGI\*\* — all expressed as membrane computing models.



Consolidates code and best features from<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span>

\- <span class="hljs-punctuation">\[</span>ReZorg/plingua<span class="hljs-punctuation">]</span>(https<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span><span class="hljs-comment">//github.com/ReZorg/plingua) — Core P-Lingua compiler/simulator</span>

\- <span class="hljs-punctuation">\[</span>ReZorg/Cytos<span class="hljs-punctuation">]</span>(https<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span><span class="hljs-comment">//github.com/ReZorg/Cytos) — C# M-systems simulator (reference XML examples)</span>

\- <span class="hljs-punctuation">\[</span>ReZorg/RRR-P-Sys-Cog<span class="hljs-punctuation">]</span>(https<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span><span class="hljs-comment">//github.com/ReZorg/RRR-P-Sys-Cog) — RR + OpenCog AGI extensions</span>

\- <span class="hljs-punctuation">\[</span>cogpy/rrpling<span class="hljs-punctuation">]</span>(https<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span><span class="hljs-comment">//github.com/cogpy/rrpling) — RR-RNN enhanced P-Lingua</span>



\## Dependencies



\* Linux OS (tested on Ubuntu <span class="hljs-number">16.04</span>+)

\* GCC <span class="hljs-number">4.9</span><span class="hljs-number">.0</span> or higher (with support for regex)

\* Flex<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> Bison

\* libboost-filesystem-dev<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> libboost-program-options-dev



```bash

sudo apt-get install build-essential flex bison libboost-filesystem-dev libboost-program-options-dev

```



\## Building



```bash

make grammar      # Generate parser from Flex/Bison

make compiler     # Build bin/plingua (P-Lingua compiler)

make simulator    # Build bin/psim (P-system simulator)

make mcompiler    # Build bin/mlingua (M-Lingua compiler)

make msimulator   # Build bin/msim (M-system simulator)

make extensions   # Build RR/OpenCog demos and tests

make all          # Build everything

sudo make install

```



\## Architecture



```

┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐

│                 Consolidated P-Lingua                    │

├──────────┬──────────┬──────────────┬────────────────────┤

│ P-Lingua │ M-Lingua │  Relevance   │   OpenCog AGI      │

│  (.pli)  │  (.mli)  │ Realization  │ (AtomSpace<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> PLN<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>   │

│          │          │ (RR-RNN)     │  ECAN<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> MOSES<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span>      │

│ Parser   │ Parser   │              │  OpenPsi<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> Scheme)  │

│ Compiler │ Compiler │ Hypergraph   │                    │

│ Simulator│ Simulator│ Dynamics     │ Cognitive Cycles   │

├──────────┴──────────┴──────────────┴────────────────────┤

│        Cereal Serialization / Cytos XML Export           │

└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

```



\## P-Lingua Core



Standard membrane computing models<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> transition<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> active membranes<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> tissue<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> SAT<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> PDP<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> SNP.



\### Examples



\* Existing runnable models<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> `examples/`

\* TODO backlog catalog (by P-system type<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> application category<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> complexity)<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> `examples/TODO\_EXAMPLES\_CATALOG.md`



\---



\## M-Lingua Extension



M-Lingua (`.mli`) extends P-Lingua with support for \*\*Morphogenetic Systems\*\* — computational models combining membrane computing with spatial geometry and polytopic tile self-assembly (based on Sosík et al. and the <span class="hljs-punctuation">\[</span>Cytos simulator<span class="hljs-punctuation">]</span>(https<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span><span class="hljs-comment">//github.com/ReZorg/Cytos)).</span>



\### M-Lingua Features



\* `@msystem\&lt;morphogenetic\&gt;` — Model declaration for M systems

\* `@tiling` block — Tile definitions with connectors<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> glues<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> and spatial properties

\* `@floating` — Floating object definitions with mobility and concentration

\* `@protion` — Protein-like markers on tiles

\* Rule types<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> `@create`<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> `@destroy`<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> `@divide`<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> metabolic rules

\* Geometry extensions<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> `@geometry`<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> `@manifold`<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> `@metric`<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> `@connection`

\* Advanced model directives<span class="hljs-punctuation">:</span> `@polytope`<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> `@flow`<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> `@capability`

\* Cytos-compatible XML output for Unity visualization



\### M-Lingua Examples



| File | Description |

|------|-------------|

| `examples/msystem/boxy\_hallows.mli` | Self-replicating boxes |

| `examples/msystem/cytoskeleton.mli` | Eukaryotic cell division |

| `examples/msystem/septum.mli` | Prokaryotic binary fission |

| `examples/msystem/ladder.mli` | Linear self-assembly |

| `examples/msystem/self\_healing.mli` | Robust membrane repair |

| `examples/msystem/tissue\_morphogenetic.mli` | Tissue-like M system |

| `examples/msystem/geometry\_120cell.mli` | Geometry-profile + <span class="hljs-number">120</span>-cell metadata example |



\### Cytos Reference XML



Original Cytos simulator XML examples in `examples/cytos\_xml/` for cross-validation.



See `docs/MLINGUA\_SPEC.md` for the full M-Lingua language specification.



\---



\## R-Lingua (Relevance Lingua<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> `.rli`)



R-Lingua is the \*\*Relevance Realization DSL\*\* — a language extension focused on Vervaeke's Relevance Realization theory with the \*\*trielectic ennead architecture\*\*.  It sits alongside P-Lingua (`.pli`) and M-Lingua (`.mli`) without changing either existing pipeline.



\### Core Concepts



| Concept | Description |

|---------|-------------|

| \*\*Trielectic ennead\*\* | <span class="hljs-number">9</span> dimensions across <span class="hljs-number">3</span> triads (Agent<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> Arena<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> Relation) |

| \*\*Grip index\*\* | Per-node measure of optimal cognitive grip ∈ <span class="hljs-punctuation">\[</span><span class="hljs-number">0</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span><span class="hljs-number">1</span><span class="hljs-punctuation">]</span> |

| \*\*Ennead balance\*\* | How evenly the <span class="hljs-number">9</span> dimensions contribute (high = stable) |

| \*\*Relevance gradient\*\* | ∇ℜ = log(affordance\_realization / affordance\_potential) |

| \*\*Emergence score\*\* | Fraction of nodes that have achieved emergent relation status |



\### Ennead Triads



| Triad | Pole | Dimensions |

|-------|------|------------|

| \*\*A\*\* | Agent | identity\_continuity<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> skill\_readiness<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> motivational\_valence |

| \*\*B\*\* | Arena | constraint\_clarity<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> affordance\_density<span class="hljs-punctuation">,</span> feedback\_latency |

| \*\*C\*\* | Relation | coupling\_strengt



\&lt;note\&gt;Content truncated. Call the fetch tool with a start\_index of <span class="hljs-number">5000</span> to get more content.\&lt;/note\&gt;

</code></pre></div></figure></div></div></div></div><div class="Tool-module\_\_toolContainer\_\_PQCpK Tool-module\_\_toolContainerInGroup\_\_bNqOy Tool-module\_\_toolContainerExpanded\_\_tkI3R" style="--tool-preview-height-threshold: 475px;"><div class="NewToolHeader-module\_\_headerContainer\_\_n5bSH"><button type="button" class="NewToolHeader-module\_\_missionControl\_\_TOr61 NewToolHeader-module\_\_inGroup\_\_Tqe3u" aria-disabled="false" aria-expanded="true" tabindex="0"><span class="NewToolHeader-module\_\_text\_\_mpVp6"><span class="NewToolHeader-module\_\_title\_\_voLMB NewToolHeader-module\_\_titleInGroup\_\_uz4Eu">Web fetch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ReZorg/plingua/547338824568810b1a14a950189e7a5dc799ee97/README.md</span></span><svg data-component="Octicon" data-expanded="true" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" class="octicon octicon-chevron-right NewToolHeader-module\_\_toggleIcon\_\_\_Azb6" viewBox="0 0 12 12" width="12" height="12" fill="currentColor" display="inline-block" overflow="visible" style="vertical-align: text-bottom;"><path d="M4.7 10c-.2 0-.4-.1-.5-.2-.3-.3-.3-.8 0-1.1L6.9 6 4.2 3.3c-.3-.3-.3-.8 0-1.1.3-.3.8-.3 1.1 0l3.3 3.2c.3.3.3.8 0 1.1L5.3 9.7c-.2.2-.4.3-.6.3Z"></path></svg></button></div><div><div class="Tool-module\_\_toolContentMissionControl\_\_fqP1\_"><div class="markdown-body MarkdownRenderer-module\_\_container\_\_sJ8jf" data-copilot-markdown="true" style="--MarkdownRenderer\_streaming-fade-duration: 750ms;"><figure class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_container\_\_EQXTk"><div class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_codeContainer\_\_YJrZ9"><pre class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_code\_\_X8Whj"><code class="ToolCodeBlock-module\_\_codeWrap\_\_HyFh6">Content type text/plain; charset=utf<span class="hljs-number">-8</span> cannot be simplified to markdown.
